name: Tasky by BotTasker
shortDescription: Build and operate BotTasker apps from Codex and Claude Code.
description: Tasky combines guided skills with the hosted BotTasker MCP to create and operate apps, data models, workflows, dashboards, boards, forms, catalogs, AI agents, knowledge bases and communication modules. Users connect through OAuth and keep their existing BotTasker roles and organization boundaries.
